exceptions.justification: Vitest UI server is never started in production or staging; vitest is used exclusively in headless runner mode ('vitest run') in isolated CI and test environments.
exceptions.exposure: Vitest UI server is never started in production or staging; vitest is used exclusively in headless runner mode ('vitest run') in isolated CI and test environments.
exceptions.mitigation: No public or network-exposed Vitest server. Scheduled for upgrade to Vitest 3.3+ in post-v1.0.0 framework maintenance.

exceptions.justification: Transitive development dependency required by @expo/cli for unpacking native mobile templates at build time; completely absent from production Next.js runtime bundles and Docker backend containers.
exceptions.exposure: Transitive development dependency required by @expo/cli for unpacking native mobile templates at build time; completely absent from production Next.js runtime bundles and Docker backend containers.
exceptions.mitigation: Isolated to developer build workstations and CI runner; upgrade scheduled with Expo SDK 52.

exceptions.justification: Advisory affects Windows-hosted Next.js servers only. WealthOS is containerized and deployed strictly on Linux (Ubuntu / Alpine) and macOS.
exceptions.exposure: Advisory affects Windows-hosted Next.js servers only. WealthOS is containerized and deployed strictly on Linux (Ubuntu / Alpine) and macOS.
exceptions.mitigation: OS platform constraint (Linux container runtime). Upgrade scheduled with Next.js 15+ post-v1.0.0.

exceptions.justification: Affects Next.js Image Optimization API when AVIF files are dynamically processed from untrusted remotes.
exceptions.exposure: Affects Next.js Image Optimization API when AVIF files are dynamically processed from untrusted remotes.
exceptions.mitigation: next/image remote optimization disabled; assets served statically via CDN. Upgrade scheduled with Next.js 15+ post-v1.0.0.

exceptions.justification: Affects Next.js Image Optimization API with untrusted remote SVG files.
exceptions.exposure: Affects Next.js Image Optimization API with untrusted remote SVG files.
exceptions.mitigation: Remote SVG optimization disabled; static internal SVGs only. Upgrade scheduled with Next.js 15+ post-v1.0.0.
